description: React component for querying and displaying vector store documents, including UI for input, results, and configuration management.

methods.name: handleVectorStoreProviderDataChange
methods.description: Updates the selected vector store provider inputs and input parameters visibility.

methods.name: chunkSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of a document chunk to show in expanded dialog.

methods.name: handleEnter
methods.description: Handles Enter key press in query input to trigger search.

methods.name: doQuery
methods.description: Performs the vector store query request.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves the current vector store configuration.

methods.name: fetchVectorStoreDetails
methods.description: Fetches and sets details for a specific vector store node.
